notablePrerequisites: Elenda has a power of three or greater.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Elenda, adding {W/B}.
When Elenda dies, its second ability triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Vampire creature tokens equal to Elenda's power.
Cast Elenda from your graveyard by paying {2}{W}{B}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Vampires, adding {2}{W/B}.
When the Vampires die, Elenda's first ability triggers three times, putting three +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.
